video_title: Extended Interview: Victor Wembanyama on playing style, training and life off the court

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on the demanding nature of the NBA schedule
quotes.excerpt: what's hard is showing up every single night over a long year
quotes.quote: In this league, in the NBA, what's hard is showing up every single night over a long year. When you take a step back, it's not a hard life. Is it demanding? Oh yes, very demanding. But not a hard life.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on the necessity of both effort and technique
quotes.excerpt: just effort is not enough and just being a technical player is not enough
quotes.quote: It's a sport where just effort is not enough and just being a technical player is not enough. You have to have a mix of both.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on why alley-oops bring him the greatest joy
quotes.excerpt: I think alley-oops in particular because alley-oops is a team play and also a dunk
quotes.quote: I think alley-oops in particular because alley-oops is a team play and also a dunk. I like alley-oops.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on the challenge of being a foreign player
quotes.excerpt: it is a difficulty first of all because of the player that I am
quotes.quote: It is a difficulty first of all because of the player that I am, but also being a foreigner here, growing up in a totally different environment. I think the key is being comfortable not knowing, being comfortable finding out my own answers.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on his admiration for the Spurs organization
quotes.excerpt: the franchise with the greatest coach of all time, the franchise with a big French history
quotes.quote: The franchise with the greatest coach of all time, the franchise with a big French history as well. It's a winning franchise.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on Gregg Popovich's lesson about humility
quotes.excerpt: after a win, you're rarely as good as you thought you were
quotes.quote: One lesson that often comes up is about humility. Gregg Popovich often said something when we were in film: after a win, you're rarely as good as you thought you were, and after a loss, you're rarely as bad as you thought you were. So, never too high, never too low.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on the freedom of being an NBA star
quotes.excerpt: if you're among the stars of this league, you really make your career whatever you want
quotes.quote: I think as an NBA player, and if you're among the stars of this league, you really make your career whatever you want to make it. Of course, you always going to do your best on the court, but on the side, you can choose to be the influencer, you can choose to be the philanthropist.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on his desire to promote healthy habits
quotes.excerpt: I want to promote healthy things and healthy I don't mean just the food
quotes.quote: I want to promote healthy things and healthy I don't mean just the food, but healthy habits, things that make people's lives better, and in the future also things that make society better, hopefully.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on overcoming his fear of being guarded
quotes.excerpt: I feel like I've grown past that edge
quotes.quote: It's been the opposite for me at some point, of course, but I feel like I've grown past that edge.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on the impact of his 2025 shoulder injury
quotes.excerpt: the condition I had early 2025, the thrombosis, it had a huge impact on this
quotes.quote: I think the condition I had early 2025, the thrombosis, it had a huge impact on this. After that, it's like life's so short, I don't even want to waste it being somebody else.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on his goal to win MVP
quotes.excerpt: I should win it this year though
quotes.quote: I should win it this year though.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on ignoring criticism during the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: I'm not paying attention to this during the finals
quotes.quote: I'm not paying attention to this during the finals. I don't think any player on either team really is.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on prioritizing winning over being liked
quotes.excerpt: you need to play basketball, you don't need to be liked by people if you want to win
quotes.quote: It showed my limits more than anything else. Going out there, you need to play basketball, you don't need to be liked by people if you want to win at least.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on the similarities between basketball and chess
quotes.excerpt: I find that chess is a lot about decision making and that looks like basketball
quotes.quote: I find that chess is a lot about decision making and that looks like basketball, at least in theory, because there are some theoretical good moves.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on why he trains barefoot
quotes.excerpt: big men have always had feet problems and I also find more and more that feet are
quotes.quote: Big men have always had feet problems and I also find more and more that feet are responsible for so much more that goes on. I try to walk barefoot as much as I can.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on strengthening his feet to prevent injury
quotes.excerpt: strengthening them and I think strengthening them first of all it takes time
quotes.quote: Strengthening them and I think strengthening them first of all it takes time. I'm better right now than I was two years ago, even better than I was five years ago.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on how shoes affect foot mechanics
quotes.excerpt: shoes like yours for example, they don't respect the natural shape of the foot
quotes.quote: You need to strengthen your feet and what shoes do, like shoes like yours for example, they don't respect the natural shape of the foot, so they don't allow it to work the way it's supposed to.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on his unique training methods
quotes.excerpt: nobody like me has trained the way I'm training and I'm trying to figure out the answers
quotes.quote: Nobody like me has trained the way I'm training and I'm trying to figure out the answers. I'm checking boxes and sometimes I try something, no, it's not working. We push it to the side, try onto the next thing, and we work on from there.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on why he chose the Spurs
quotes.excerpt: because of the franchise, because of the history I know this is where I belong
quotes.quote: Because of the franchise, because of the history I know this is where I belong.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on the pros and cons of San Antonio
quotes.excerpt: good is how you never feel like you're never judged for being ambitious
quotes.quote: Good is how you never feel like you're never judged for being ambitious. Bad, I would say I think the social interactions are more shallow here, more not as in depth as what I've seen in other countries.
